notes.title: Small But Mighty Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300800/6ba6dc407b22a5bd15d670bbcb1435a221b1ecd1.png[/img]
 New Sound Effects – Get ready for a more immersive adventure with brand-new sounds that bring the game to life!
Added Beds – Find new beds in the game and recharge in style.

It's a small update, but it makes a BIG difference! Jump back in and enjoy the latest improvements. As always, keep the feedback coming!

Update now and keep the hype alive!
